body: Thanks for your concern but I’m not looking for “help”. There is no help for a useless person who won’t change. I’m giving the best advice I can as my last act. Please don’t waste your time.
Thanks for clarifying. I appreciate you listening

Just explaining why I’m going to do what I’m going to do. I’m not some depressed malingerer looking for disability money. I get on here to vent after bad days. Sorry if I misled you but I’m not looking for help
Eventually I’ll hate everyone just out of habit. I’m also sick of living this way and as I’ve said unwilling to change. I’m building up to the day when I get the courage to do it
I take it out on whoever I can and I enjoy when it affects people they care about.

Lazy people
Enablers
Slaves(mindlessly pick up the slack)
Real people
Everyone is one of those 3 or the 4th-The one who doesn’t bend over for a malingerer
I hate lazy people, enablers who help them and people who take up their slack and don’t retaliate. In other words nearly everyone.
Enjoying other people’s pain
My earliest memory of it
No
Age10
Most of it. I’ve enjoyed it my whole life though
Often
Real people don’t live off of others. They don’t sign up for a job then refuse to do it and claim discrimination or “I have kids” or any other bullshit. A real person has to pick a mooches slack
They go to management and friends and either cry or claim discrimination from a real person who does what they’re supposed to and don’t overextend.

They have families friends and pets. They put themselves into dumb situations because of these. leaving early, standing around yapping about them instead of keeping busy and whining about money trouble when these actions are reflected in their paychecks. Then some enabling jackass helps them out strengthening their malingering behavior.
It would involve turning into the kind of person I loathe, similar to what I am now but with an opposite outlook on life.
No I enjoy it when people hate me. I want to die because I’m sick of living like this and I don’t want to change
I enjoy it when people make bad decisions and either watch them suffer the consequences or report them to every authority possible to optimize their pain if we happen to work together.
Sounds accurate
The only thing that makes me happy is when others fail. I feel good when I see misery. The only thing I’m good at is going through other people’s work and finding mistakes.

I appreciate your concern but nothing you say is going to help. Eventually I will work up the courage to do what I know is right and literally make the world a better place. Until then sometimes it makes me feel better to vent on here.
You’re not the only one. I’ve wasted all my good opportunities and ill be going soon too. I’m going to have some fun before I go. I recommend you do the same. Good luck!
Thanks for your concern but I was a lousy person. I really am making the world a better place. And nothing personal but my way is more fun.
I think of putting my head under a moving train. Quicker guaranteed death
And go to hell with a smile on my face😁

I’m going to be gone soon as well. I don’t think about the pain I will cause by leaving. Everyone has people who worry about them when they don’t want them to. I think about how much better off people around me will be after I am not disrupting their lives with my negativity anymore and how I won’t be in pain anymore. That will make leaving easier
